title: avena bromoides subsp. pruinosa
intro: Avena bromoides subsp. pruinosa, commonly known as oat grass, is a subspecies of the oat grass plant (Avena bromoides), a perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of oat grass include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to reduce stress and alleviate symptoms associated with anxiety and insomnia. Avena bromoides subsp. pruinosa contains bioactive constituents such as avenanthramides, avenacosides, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
